blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co switched from duraboxes to “maleta” (suitcases) to transport kickbacks worth up to P40 million per delivery due to durability issues, state witness and former Public Works engineer Henry Alcantara said on Tuesday. Alcantara made the statement during his testimony before the Sandiganbayan Third Division at former House Speaker Martin Romualdez’s bail hearing for his plunder case stemming from alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion.
